s.discard(9)

name: S16 列表与集合不相等/互转
code:
s = {1, 2}
xs = list(s)
print(len(xs))
print(sorted(xs))
t = set(xs)
print(len(t))

name: S17 in 与 add 混用
code:
s = {1}
print(1 in s)
print(2 in s)
s.add(2)
print(2 in s)
s.remove(1)
print(1 in s)

name: S19 布尔与循环
code:
s = {3, 1}
s.add(2)
t = 0
for x in s:
    t = t + x
print(t)
print(sorted(s))
